calls.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: M7 Drowned Bell-Ringer front model sheet for a serialized comic. Native canvas 1536 by 1024 pixels, landscape PNG.
Sheet recipe: orthographic full-body FRONT view, camera square to the figure at mid-body height, no perspective exaggeration. Soft neutral key light from the upper left. Flat solid light grey #E9E9EC background edge to edge, no vignette, no ground texture, only a tiny contact shadow beneath each foot. The creature ALONE, centered, fills nearly the canvas height from bell crown to bare soles, full figure and entire weapon contained. No scale silhouette, no other figures, no labels or extra detail insets.
The creature stands neutrally with a credible planted weight. Body proportions: long legs occupying about half the full height, massive upper body and very long arms, huge hands reaching near knees. Bell head about one sixth of total height; head is literally a hanging downward-opening church bell seated on the neck, no human skull, no helmet and no face. Bell has a plain stepped crown, two simple cast ridges around its flared rim, and an irregular Hush split down its anatomical LEFT side (picture-right in front view). A few violet ash flakes #6B4C9A emerge only from that split, whose core is #1A1026. Bronze #8A6A3A with dull verdigris #5B7868 patches; no lettering, carved symbols or fancy ornament.
Thick drowned grey stone limbs #737B80 with a single cool hard shadow #515D68 and a few restrained hand-inked rough chips, not faceted stone armour. Dark navy blue robe #25384D, shadow #182535, sleeveless shoulders with worn cloth wrapping the torso, tied by a rusted chain at the waist; skirt falls to mid shin with just a few frayed notches. A short rusted chain collar sits below the bell and one chain drapes diagonally across the chest; all links are coherent and countable, no random hanging hardware. No additional armour, boots, horns or accessories.
His anatomical RIGHT hand (picture-left) firmly holds ONE enormous aged-bronze bell-clapper hammer: a long tree-trunk-thick cylindrical shaft ending in a heavy elongated rounded teardrop striking weight, like a detached church bell's internal clapper. Total length approximately 4 m against his 6 m body. The handle is nearly vertical beside his right leg, striking bulb rests on the ground; it is a plain bell clapper, never a transverse mallet, axe or spiked mace. His left hand rests open beside his thigh with four distinct fingers and a thumb. Keep the simple broad robe shadow shapes and hand-drawn ink clear at phone size.

A hushed giant 6 m tall: a body like drowned grey stone wrapped in rotting dark-blue robes and rusted chains; long arms, huge hands; in place of a head, a cracked bronze cathedral bell green with age, a violet Hush crack down its side leaking ash, darkness inside its mouth. Its hammer is a bell clapper the size of a tree trunk. When it tolls, a ring of force bursts out a step beyond its own reach; inside its arm's length the force passes over you. Borro reaches its waist; Jaeha its knee.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
calls.reason: Rendered mottled texture and small shadow shards on stone/cloth; extensively shredded hem. Fails style 11b.1, 2 and 6.
